about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Introduction
description: I am a technology and software development enthusiast, passionate about transforming ideas into digital solutions that bring real value. My constant curiosity drives me to explore key areas of current and future technology, such as AI and data science.

I am motivated to learn and apply new tools and methodologies that enhance the creation of efficient and scalable projects. I enjoy tackling technical challenges and collaborating in multidisciplinary teams to achieve innovative solutions.

description.name: AI-powered document analysis
description.text: Development of a full-stack application for automated document processing, integrating OCR and LLM-based capabilities to extract and analyze information from unstructured documents.

description.name: Breast cancer analysis
description.text: Benchmarked deep learning models and studied the relationship between medical imaging features, protein expression and genetic mutations for breast cancer characterization.

description.name: Foundation model fusion
description.text: Developed ensemble-based approaches combining complementary foundation models to improve medical image classification performance.

description.name: Out-of-domain generalization
description.text: Investigated model fusion strategies to improve robustness and generalization in medical image analysis under distribution shifts.
